_notes.llm: Any model from https://ollama.com/library works. qwen2.5:14b needs about 10 GB of GPU memory. Higher quality options for a strong GPU: qwen2.5:32b (about 20 GB) and llama3.1:70b (about 43 GB). For slower machines try qwen2.5:7b.
_notes.documents: Writes tailored resumes and cover letters (dashboard: Generate Documents). A larger model writes better; qwen2.5:32b needs about 21 GB of GPU memory. On smaller cards use qwen2.5:14b here too. keep_alive frees its memory a few minutes after the last document.
_notes.embedding: provider 'ollama' with model 'nomic-embed-text' needs no extra Python packages. provider 'sentence-transformers' with model 'BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5' is slightly more accurate but needs PyTorch (a large download).
